# JuliaApprox { #pyratfun.JuliaApprox }

```python
JuliaApprox(julia_obj)
```

Base class for rational function approximations.

Wraps Julia's AbstractApproximation type, providing methods for evaluating
approximations, analyzing their properties, and managing the approximation
history.

Attributes:
    julia: The underlying Julia approximation object.

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [check](#pyratfun.JuliaApprox.check) | Check the quality of the approximation. |
| [degree](#pyratfun.JuliaApprox.degree) | Get the total degree of the approximation. |
| [degrees](#pyratfun.JuliaApprox.degrees) | Get the numerator and denominator degrees. |
| [get](#pyratfun.JuliaApprox.get) | Get a property from the underlying Julia object. |
| [isempty](#pyratfun.JuliaApprox.isempty) | Check if the approximation is empty/undefined. |
| [poles](#pyratfun.JuliaApprox.poles) | Compute the poles of the approximation. |
| [residues](#pyratfun.JuliaApprox.residues) | Compute poles and their residues. |
| [rewind](#pyratfun.JuliaApprox.rewind) | Rewind the approximation history by n steps. |
| [roots](#pyratfun.JuliaApprox.roots) | Compute the zeros of the approximation. |
